in_marathi.name: Tultul
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lotus in Water
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tultul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tultul is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Tulasi’ which means lotus. The lotus is considered a sacred symbol of purity and creation, and is often depicted in water. This name is believed to bring blessings of fertility and abundance.
